name: Issue 74 real read-file benchmark

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - lib/utf8.lisp
      - scripts/benchmark-semantic-registry-read.lisp
      - .github/workflows/issue-74-real-readfile-benchmark.yml

jobs:
  benchmark:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
      HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: dtolnay/rust-toolchain@stable
      - uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@v2
        with:
          shared-key: issue-74-real-readfile
      - name: Preserve benchmark harness
        run: cp scripts/benchmark-semantic-registry-read.lisp /tmp/benchmark-semantic-registry-read.lisp
      - name: Measure base on this runner
        run: |
          git checkout --detach "$BASE_SHA"
          cargo build -p my-lisp-cli --bin my-lisp
          echo '--- BASE ---'
          /usr/bin/time -f 'base_wall_seconds=%e' \
            ./target/debug/my-lisp /tmp/benchmark-semantic-registry-read.lisp
      - name: Measure candidate on this runner
        run: |
          git checkout --detach "$HEAD_SHA"
          cargo build -p my-lisp-cli --bin my-lisp
          echo '--- CANDIDATE ---'
          /usr/bin/time -f 'candidate_wall_seconds=%e' \
            ./target/debug/my-lisp /tmp/benchmark-semantic-registry-read.lisp
